sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Product-focused operations professional with 5+ years driving cross-functional project ownership and stakeholder alignment across €100M+ investment initiatives. Proven experience in roadmap execution, compliance oversight, and executive communication within fintech and investment environments. Track record of delivering results through data-driven decision making and bias for action in fast-paced, customer-obsessed organizations.

bullets: Owned end-to-end project roadmaps for 4 concurrent large-scale investment initiatives valued at €100M+, delivering [X]% on-time completion rate through systematic milestone tracking and risk mitigation

Led cross-functional collaboration across [X] internal stakeholders and [X] external partners, orchestrating design, content, and operations teams to ensure seamless product alignment and feature delivery
Drove executive communication strategy by preparing and delivering [X] high-impact investor presentations monthly, influencing €[X]M in funding decisions through compelling data storytelling
Established and optimized compliance frameworks for [X] strategic initiatives, reducing regulatory risk by [X]% while accelerating time-to-market for critical product features
Implemented data-driven project tracking systems using advanced analytics, improving cross-departmental visibility and reducing communication overhead by [X]%
Championed customer-obsessed approach by translating investor feedback into actionable product requirements, directly contributing to [X]% improvement in stakeholder satisfaction scores
Demonstrated bias for action by proactively identifying and resolving [X] critical project bottlenecks, preventing potential delays worth €[X]M in project value

sections.title: Skills
sections.content:
• Product Operations: Roadmap Planning, Feature Requirements, Stakeholder Management, Cross-functional Leadership
• Analytics & Tools: MS Project, Trello, Asana, Data Analysis, Performance Metrics
• Executive Communication: PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides, Investor Relations, Strategic Presentations
• Languages: French (native), English (fluent), Spanish (conversational)

Management of cross-departmental communication between design, content, and operations teams
Tracking and overseeing ongoing tasks and deadlines for compliance and strategic initiatives
Close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to ensure project alignment

metrics.question: What was the typical timeline for these €100M+ projects and what percentage were delivered on schedule?
metrics.reason: On-time delivery metrics are crucial for demonstrating project management effectiveness and results delivery

metrics.question: How many internal and external stakeholders did you typically coordinate across these cross-departmental projects?
metrics.reason: Stakeholder count demonstrates scope of influence and coordination complexity

metrics.question: How frequently did you deliver these investor presentations and what was the typical audience size?
metrics.reason: Presentation frequency and audience size shows communication impact and stakeholder engagement level

metrics.question: What was the average project value and how many compliance initiatives did you oversee simultaneously?
metrics.reason: Project portfolio size and compliance scope demonstrates operational capacity and risk management

summary.draft_summary: Mid-level operations professional with 5+ years driving project coordination and stakeholder alignment across €100M+ investment initiatives. Proven experience in cross-functional team management, compliance oversight, and executive communication within finance and investment environments.

competitive.realistic_target_level: Associate Product Manager or Program Manager
competitive.honest_feedback: Current profile shows strong operational coordination but lacks direct product management experience, user research, or roadmap ownership. Better suited for Associate PM or Program Manager roles where project coordination skills transfer well. Senior PM at Amazon requires proven product strategy and feature definition experience not evident in current background.
